deploy.//: Auto-apply pending Prisma migrations BEFORE booting the API. 2026-05-04 — first attempt put `pnpm --filter @cms/database run db:deploy && node ...` directly here; that boot went in_progress → inactive in 17s with no useful Railway log surface (silent crash, possibly a startCommand parser quirk or pnpm path issue in the runner stage). Replaced with an explicit shell script (scripts/railway-start.sh) that prints step-by-step status, fails fast on missing DATABASE_URL, calls the prisma binary directly without going through pnpm, then execs node. If migrations fail the script's set -e propagates → Railway restartPolicy retries 10× and the failing step is visible in the deploy log instead of a generic 'inactive'.
deploy.//healthcheckPath: 2026-09-05 (P0-7 finding #3) — moved from /api/v1/health to /api/v1/health/started. /health is the LIVENESS probe and is deliberately always-200 (CLAUDE.md: never add DB checks to liveness), so it went green the instant the process bound its port — Railway then switched the fleet onto a container whose Prisma pool was cold and whose Redis client was not connected, and 1,000 screens arrived at once (measured: 31% of requests failing for ~20s, 49/1000 screens not re-authenticated at 15s). /health/started is a ONE-WAY LATCH: 503 until the DB has served a real query and Redis has settled, 200 forever after. It cannot re-close, so a later Supabase blip can never fail a deploy or cycle a pod the way pointing this at /health/ready would; and it opens on a 45s ceiling even if the database never answers, because a gate that never opens is a worse outage than a cold start. /health is UNCHANGED and remains the liveness endpoint.
deploy.//healthcheckTimeout: 2026-06-28 — bumped 60→300. Two consecutive deploys (74e26f92, 15d680f3) FAILED the healthcheck (Docker build green, image pushed) because a cold boot — railway-start.sh `prisma migrate deploy` + NestJS module init + a cold Supabase pool (slow queries ~343ms each, plus a 1Hz Game.findMany background poller adding pool contention) — exceeded the 60s window. This does NOT weaken the gate: restartPolicy (10×) and the always-200 /health liveness endpoint are unchanged; it only tolerates a slow-but-healthy boot so the deploy stops getting killed mid-startup. Follow-up: the 1Hz Game.findMany poller is an efficiency + boot-contention bug worth fixing so 60s is safe again.
